scope: GC24: finite ordered node-free scalar captures around one mutable one-level array in an authenticated active direct real Closure caller.
target: PHP 8.5.10 CLI NTS 64-bit; LC_ALL=C; TZ=UTC; tests/semantics/profile.json
rule: One DIRECT array capture may occur anywhere among finite DIRECT defined node-free scalar captures. Its finite entries are DIRECT node-free scalars or distinct allocated childless STDINSTANCE leaves; ordinary and physical edges must agree. The array must be allocated, mutable, outside compiled-pool reach and outside materialized object-property tables. Authentic selected direct Closure caller and machine root remain required. Existing exact array clauses retain their prior admissions; a legacy-shape guard keeps the new rule disjoint from them. Graph, owner, buffer and count algorithms are unchanged.

validation.native: Six pinned controls pass, including reversed Reflection capture order, duplicate leaf identity and childless-array COW. The three distinct mixed-key original and its post-capture COW variant both exit 0 with empty stderr. The independent pinned native COW report agrees with the committed source bytes.
validation.preedit: At source-only a3e, reversed capture and duplicate child sources exit 1 Unsupported cached ordinary property-table collection and earn zero agreement; childless COW already agrees. The first generic draft caused an interpreter nondeterminism on childless COW because it overlapped an older exact clause. Its raw failed report is retained; the legacy-shape exclusion restores exact COW behavior.
validation.source: At clean semantic 90ef, reversed scalar/array capture, three distinct mixed-key leaves and three-leaf post-capture COW each have byte-exact native/model stdout and stderr and exit 0: three source agreements. All report inputs and HEADs are stable, with no timeout or surviving child process group.
validation.reached: Strict SL passes the corrected GC23 group (110), new reversed-capture group (113) and three-leaf group (146). Genuine D states bind capture and entry order, array/leaf owners, buffer order, black protection and count-plan removal. Negatives refuse duplicate object edges, a separately captured shared leaf, ALIAS/INDIRECT or nested entries, PUNDEFINED, a destructor-bearing child, a direct pool root, a materialized proxy table and caller/source erasures. GC23's historical swapped-order refusal was replaced because GC24 admits that order. The initial pool-fixture syntax failure is retained and the affected group passed after correction. The pool mutation tests a direct root; descendant exclusion follows the finite heap-reach definition.
validation.runtime: The pinned six-case native phase and all three final model cases use the recorded profile with CLI opcache/JIT disabled. The final model cases take 72, 112 and 120 seconds respectively under 240-second caps.

limits: Duplicate object identities, separately captured shared objects, ALIAS and INDIRECT entries, nested arrays, user destructor children, materialized property tables and compiled-pool descendants remain outside the new generic rule. Older exact clauses retain their own historical scope, including any pool-reachable childless states. Explicit Closure __invoke uses its separate GC11 admission. General cyclic, reference and finalizer-bearing graphs remain partial.
recovery: Raw pinned native/model sources, stdout, stderr, failed attempts and strict fixtures are outside Git under ../php-spec-evidence-archive/gc-finite-capture-review-probes and gc-finite-capture-24-dev.
